binding.binding_rule: pr_head_run: this was a pull_request-triggered run, so the receipt's github_sha 7e5e1b49c5b1ba55d78b79f5b5adec5ca5ed2d92 is the merge-ref commit refs/pull/1561/merge, whose second parent is the PR head 39b68f573ab3e0c0f7ac29acd7b85c775a77871a. It is NOT the branch head and must not be read as one. The UTV2-1641 harvester cannot produce this block pre-merge: locateCiDbProofRun step 1 calls findWorkflowJobForHeadSha(mergeSha) and on a hit labels the result identity_source 'merge_sha_run', which then demands receipt.github_sha === mergeSha exactly and fails closed with receipt_invalid. Its own correct 'pr_head_run' branch is reachable only via the step-2 fallback and is shadowed. This block was therefore assembled by hand from the downloaded artifact and the job log; it was not harvested.

runtime_proof.note: SCOPE. Unlike this lane's earlier evidence, this is a UTV2-1861-SPECIFIC live assertion, not only the generic staging smoke. Four cases in t1-proof-utv2-1251-evidence-settlement.test.ts executed against staging with skipped 0, and two of them are new in this lane and exercise the widened guard directly. What it does NOT prove: that the deployed Smart Form produces a validated Track Only pick. The fixture submits with source 'api' because validateSmartFormRelationships (submit-pick-controller.ts:46) applies the full Smart Form contract to any smart-form payload carrying a distributionMode, and satisfying it would make this proof depend on staging reference-data coverage that containment deliberately leaves unpopulated -- testing the catalog, not the guard. isEvidencePlanePick reads exactly two fields, status and metadata, and reads neither source nor any Smart Form field. That the deployed form produces such a pick is Milestone 1's evidence (production pick dfcd9486-cba2-4bb5-b684-beec36e52c0b), not this file's. Both fixtures in the first staging attempt were REFUSED and both refusals were defects in the fixtures rather than in the guard; that run is recorded in verification.md rather than discarded, because the control's first form discriminated on lifecycle state instead of on the Track Only marker and would have left the positive case satisfied by a guard admitting the whole pre-delivery backlog.
